title: NFL implements stricter rules for images displayed on stadium video boards during field goals and extra points after Patriots' ploy is uncovered

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL implements stricter rules for images displayed on stadium video boards during field goals and extra points after Patriots' ploy is uncovered
sources.description: A former NFL analytics coach discovered that the Patriots displayed goalposts on their video board, creating visual distortion for kickers.
